title: Dual-passivation buried interface molecular bridges for efficient carbon-based CsPbIxBr3−x perovskite solar cells
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00819K, Paper
Guangli Liu, Haoju Li, Changzhong Wang, Yuhang Liang, Cheng Huang, Yaochen Xie, Longxiang Luo, Yannan Qian
We designed a dual-passivation buried interface molecular bridge to connect the SnO2 and the CsPbIxBr3−x layer, achieving a power conversion efficiency of 15.51% for carbon-based all-inorganic perovskite solar cells.
